copy.title: Comp line
copy.body: The Kid Detective meets Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes. A burned-out professional stuck in a shrinking, repeating world, played as dark comedy with a puzzle at its center. Both comps are recent, indie in scale and sit at 0.98 and 0.95 fit to the touchstones.
copy.hint: The one-line "X meets Y" that opens every pitch.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Pitch deck: comps slide
copy.body: Last Dance is a time-loop dark comedy in the line of Palm Springs and Groundhog Day, with the family stakes and bite of Ready or Not and the emotional reach of Everything Everywhere All at Once. Closest comps: The Kid Detective (fit 0.98, Niche, Top 5%) for the washed-up lead in a sour, funny world; Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes (fit 0.95, Mid-list, Top 4%) for the loop as a contained paradox among friends; Come to Daddy (fit 0.96, Niche, Top 8%) for the tonal swerve. An American Pickle and I Want You Back show recent comedies built on a high concept and personal stakes. All comps are 2019 or later. Audience: skews female, over-indexes under 25 and 35–44, and favors philosophical, psychological, subtly intense and family-drama material.
copy.hint: Comps and audience for a pitch deck or financing package.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Who it's for
copy.body: The audience over-indexes female (0.38) and skews under 25 (+0.17) and 35–44 (+0.11), with the weakest index at 30–34 (-0.51). Their taste descriptors are philosophical, twist ending, psychological, family drama, whimsy and subtly intense, which fits a loop story with a family secret at its center. They also like Extraordinary and Somebody Somewhere on TV, podcasts such as 2 Dope Queens and Anna Faris Is Unqualified, and artists like Olivia Rodrigo and Billie Eilish. Strongest markets: Austin and Anchorage read as hidden gems; Los Angeles, Seattle, San Francisco and Miami are emerging.
copy.hint: A short, evidence-backed paragraph about the audience.
copy.author: llm

copy.body: For fans of Palm Springs, Groundhog Day, The Kid Detective and Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes: a time-loop comedy with a darker streak.

copy.title: Ad hooks
copy.body:
• Fans of Palm Springs: another loop, another party you can't leave, and this time someone's grandmother knows why.
• Fans of The Kid Detective: a washed-up professional with one case he can't quit, and it plays out on a dance floor.
• Fans of Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes: the same few hours, over and over, and one person in the room who isn't surprised.

kit.headline: Palm Springs and Groundhog Day supply the loop, Ready or Not and Everything Everywhere All at Once the dark, strange comedy, and recent indie comps like The Kid Detective and Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes show the audience is already there.
kit.summary: Last Dance sits in the recent indie time-loop and dark comedy lane, close to The Kid Detective, Come to Daddy and Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, all with very high fit to the touchstones. The audience skews female and leans toward under-25s and 35–44s, with a clear dip at 30–34. Lead with the loop-plus-grandmother mystery and a pairing that shows both the genre and the tone. Affinity is aggregate taste, not a forecast.
